explication: Mangle is an embeddable Go implementation of an extended Datalog language. The main workflow is to parse source into rules and declarations, validate and analyze the program, then evaluate it against facts and expose query results. The engine supports recursive bottom-up evaluation, while temporal evaluation and interval-backed facts serve temporal rules. Built-in functions and aggregation extend rule execution; the library also offers interactive use, package structuring, and provenance explanations. Edges reflect README statements or source-index references; unsampled implementation details are not assumed.
